blind.description: A stylized fantasy blacksmith shop hanging sign. It consists of a dark metal wall-mounting bracket with a square mounting plate, a horizontal crossbar, and an end cap. Two riveted metal straps suspend a shield-shaped wooden sign. The sign features a chunky reddish-orange wooden border, a light-toned wooden face, and raised reliefs of a dark iron anvil crossed with a wooden-handled hammer on both sides. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with clean geometry. The model rests on the bottom tip of the shield sign without any extra plinth or base.
blind.from_above: A horizontal dark metal bar with a square mounting flange on one side, an end cap on the other, and two bracket clasps gripping the top of a thick shield-shaped sign.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third to two-fifths the height of the figure (around 2 to 2.5 ft tall) and approximately 2.5 ft wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.45x off the catalog (2.5 x 0.7 ft)
